Name: Visible Wormies
Author: Pacizou
Description:
[center]﻿[/center][center][size=3]﻿[color=yellow][/size][size=4][/size][size=4]Are you also struggling to find worms on the map?
[/size][size=4]Do you want to use your big monitor and larg FOV without struggling to find these digging spots?
Then this mod is for you![/color][/size][size=4][/size]

I have created simple Content Patch that adds little [color=red][b]red animated circle[/b][/color] on worms sprite, this was these little digging spot are super obvious and you will never miss them again.
Mod was created with 1.6 in mind so both original "brown" as well as new "green" digging spots are included.[/center]

Manifest.Name: Visible Wormies
Manifest.Description: Makes red circle on worms sprite to find them easier.
